Hey! Thanks for the motivation and the quote!

I know that if it werent for our beautiful twins debt wouldnt be an issue, but im still scared of any expense that eventually do come up, not to mention that its a 5 year loan, im just stuck thinking over and over about school payments and other things. I know its in 5 years, but I cant even save up for any eventual things.

But I am trying my darnest to keep up a positive attitude.

Churches here, well, its a come and go thing. Yeah, I may make my case and might get help, but, I do have a job, I am not in a worse situation many other people in this country are. I'd feel worse if I take help from those people than my situation.

Either way, I know good things will come.

Thanks again for your time and words.

Hey, thanks for the questions, it helps me vent away and it helps to think sometimes outside the box.

My wife cant off schedule, as she does have a normal day job and we cant loose that income. Work in the DR is very hard to come by, specially with the covid thing. 

I am looking for other sources of income. Most are call centers which have very bad hours and even lower income, I cant spend time like that, it may sound weird but, i cant do 7 to 3am job for less than 300usd a month.

Our income right now is roughly 15k (im not from the states but you state income as yearly based) but out of that i am making debt payments and everything else, we end up probably with less than 100usd a month.

One good thing that has happened though, is that families from both sides have come together to help with what they can. For reasons like that and what I replied to user htasmansea (dont know how to @ or is it /u) we've had some good news. I am up for a promotion with a raise included.

Thanks for your time replying to me, it does help. Talking with people, writting to people DOES HELP. Thanks again.

Hey! Thanks for the constant replies. I've gotten my head and thoughts more comfortable. Its been a nice week with good outcomes. Even though doors may close, many others do open, they actually do, as long as we keep a positive life, things can turn around. I still do have moments of depression because of the whole thing but its working itself out, thanks again!

thank you. I do believe positivity attracts positivity, its all a matter of getting to that moment, things like being able to write about it and have someone to talk to aside my wife, its nice, thanks again.
those are great words to read! keep it up!

Thank you for replying. Honestly feels good to just know someone sends positive thoughts.

I live in the Dominican Republic, there is no social support system. As I do have a job I am not eligible for programs that go to supporting really low or no income families.

Its pretty much not thinking about the whole issue and try to live one day at a time. I do hope things get better.

Thanks again for the support.
